# EZ TMS

> EZ TMS (formerly EZLoader TMS) is a cloud-based transportation management system (TMS) built specifically for freight brokerages. Founded inside a freight brokerage in 2011, it covers the full load cycle — quote, book, move, bill — for both full truckload and LTL shipping, with flat-rate pricing and no per-load fees.

Key facts:
- Product: cloud-based TMS for freight brokerages (not shippers or carriers)
- Pricing: $500/month flat rate, includes 3 user seats; no per-load fees, no integration setup fees, no feature gates
- Rebrand: EZLoader TMS became EZ TMS in 2026 — same company, same product
- Features: built-in CRM, digital documentation/e-sign, team task manager, automated batch invoicing, live rating and capacity, freight matching, customer portals, digital carrier onboarding, live tracking, live dashboards, LTL portal
- EDI: offered through a partnership with Bitfreighter (X12 204, 990, 214, 210, 997), flat monthly pricing per trading partner
- Contact: (855) 594-8342, Sales@EZ-TMS.com
